text: Regulatory caution produces a systematic disconnect between the regulation of an innovation and the commercial and consumer ability to access it.
citation: Mark Fenwick, Wulf A. Kaal, Erik P. M. Vermeulen, Regulation Tomorrow What Happens When Technology Is Faster Than the Law (2017). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=2834531

isBasedOn.name: Regulation Tomorrow What Happens When Technology Is Faster Than the Law

abstract: The result is that, all too often, there is a disconnect between regulation and commercial and consumer access to that innovation.
